title: MAGPIE MORNING SWING
style: vintage electro swing 120 BPM, brushed swing drums, upright bass walking groove, brass section, vintage piano chords, subtle kookaburra call ambience intro, magpie warble texture, warm tape-style production, male vocal smooth tone, uplifting chorus
lyrics:
[INTRO – distant kookaburra laugh, soft piano]

[HOOK]
West coast swing
Hear the magpie sing
Pelican rising
Morning on the wing

[VERSE 1]
Pink-grey galahs in the sky
Sun over Swan drifting by
Pete at the helm, smooth and slow
River like glass in the early glow

Brandon built decks strong and wide
Livewire waiting with ocean pride
Steel and timber, salt and sound
Western rhythm all around

[PRE-CHORUS]
Kookaburra laugh at dawn
Day is calling, lines are drawn

[CHORUS]
Swing it west, swing it free
Indian Ocean melody
Pelican glide, Livewire shine
Western water, perfect line

[VERSE 2]
Rottnest blue and Carnac sand
Corporate cheers with a drink in hand
Bucks crew loud in the afternoon
Sunset rising like a tune

Abrolhos coral under light
Montebello clear and bright
From river cruise to island stay
Western coast leads the way

[BRIDGE – softer]
Magpie harmony in the trees
Salt wind rolling on the breeze

[FINAL CHORUS – full brass]
Swing it west, swing it high
Galah wings across the sky
Pelican roll, Livewire glide
Western Australia pride

[OUTRO – piano + bird ambience fade]
